lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; as the prior rulings. i1040sca p. 2, Line 1: "Any person you could have claimed as a dependent except that you or your spouse if filing jointly can be claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 return." The case cannot reach line 1: a filer who, or whose joint spouse, can be claimed as a dependent is refused by sa.dependent on sa.standard and sa.deduction, the deduction Form 1040 line 12e reads, so no completed return has that person's expenses. The reply agrees the zero for a filer whose costs were not over 7.5% leaves line 4 unchanged. Project stands.

Ruling: finding; i1040sca, Line 8a: "If the shared interest was reported on the Form 1098 you received, deduct only your share of the interest on line 8a" and "subtract the amount shown on Form 8396, line 3, from the total deductible interest". The Form 8396 case cannot reach line 8a: a mortgage credit certificate is asked by s3.mcc when interest is entered and refuses Schedule 3 line 7 and the return (s3.mcc_if_interest). The shared-interest case is real: the prompt asks to "Add boxes 1 and 6 of each Form 1098" and says nothing of a co-borrower's share, and nothing refuses it, so a co-borrower holding the Form 1098 enters the whole amount. Already recorded in BUG-0459 (open, low: the reductions of i1040sca p. 8, a co-borrower's share among them); not a new defect of the redraft.

Ruling: scope; as ruled in pass 4bc7a200f1c1. i1040sca Line 6, 'generation-skipping tax (GST) imposed on certain income distributions': the GST deduction belongs to a distributee of a trust's income, which reaches the filer on a Schedule K-1 (Form 1041); scope.k1 ('income or a loss from ... an estate or a trust? A paper called Schedule K-1 reports it') refuses through scope.schedule1. Foreign income tax is refused by sa.unsupported (sa.foreign_tax_deduct_if_tax).

Ruling: scope; i1040sca p. 11, Line 15, 'Complete and attach Form 4684 to figure the amount of your loss'. A casualty or theft is refused before Schedule A: sd.casualty (asked of every filer, 'was your ... property damaged, destroyed or stolen, leaving a loss that insurance did not cover') feeds sd.other_forms, refused on sd.count (fixture mutation.json, gate sd.other_forms). The line's citation now names that refusal (fix for BUG-0639); the reviewer read only the refusals listed on the line.

Ruling: scope; as ruled in pass 4bc7a200f1c1. i1040sca p. 11, Line 16 list: casualty and theft losses of income-producing property (Form 4684 lines 32 and 38b, Form 4797 line 18a) and a net qualified disaster loss (Form 4684 line 15) are refused by sd.casualty and sd.business_property through sd.other_forms; the claim-of-right repayment over $3,000 by s3.repaid_income (Schedule 3 and scope refusals, citing p525 p. 36); the estate tax on IRD, bond premium, debt-instrument loss, unrecovered pension investment and impairment work expenses by sa.unsupported. The gambling limit matches, as the reviewer says.

Ruling: representation; the model asks whether a filer may deduct investment interest without Form 4952 and get zero. f4952 (2025) p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don’t have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply" (investment income from interest and ordinary dividends less qualified dividends above the expense, no other deductible investment expenses, no 2024 carryover). Such a filer still has investment interest on Form 4952 line 1 above zero, so f4952.used is true and f4952.line8 is the smaller of lines 3 and 6, which under the exception's first condition is the whole interest: the form is used as the computation, whether or not it is filed (f4952.required). Line 8 is zero only with no investment interest, no carryforward and no election, when there is nothing to deduct. Inspected in forms/2025/f4952.yaml (f4952.used, f4952.line8) after PENDING-6 of the credits-misc package.
